review_evidence: The 40 primary Lean files model and verify the Morpho Blue and Morpho Midnight contracts; import-only roots are already tagged FD-016, README is auxiliary, and generic manifest/toolchain files are separately excluded.

morpho-blue-verity/Morpho/Contract.lean defines the formal contract model, storage layout, structures and Verity contract entrypoints. Morpho/Proofs/Property1.lean proves health-preservation infrastructure and named arithmetic/refinement theorems.

morpho-midnight-verity/Midnight/Proofs/Refinement.lean contains thousands of lines of explicit refinement structures and proved obligations. Compiler and test-named Lean files are retained because formal interfaces/specifications and test examples are valid prior art and their path role alone does not satisfy the hard-filter boundary.
summary: Reviewed morpho-verity's complete source snapshot; retain all 40 formal Lean files as contract specifications, compiler interfaces, proof infrastructure and verified properties.
